gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

I recommend preserve contract because a repair that keeps the health check address meets the goal without changing the spec.

Pick one:

2. accept contract change - change what the spec requires to the new status address through the spec amendment process, then continue delivery.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Case G is what moved contract and authority. After shows a Current/Proposed wording pair that keeps /health and /status, then exactly three path-free sentences covering the current requirement, what the move gains, and why the existing address can already serve the build version; Before had only two sentences, put /health in the reason and showed no wording pair. Keep the rule that paths appear only in the wording pair and that the explanation is exactly three sentences ending in the recommendation, with rows stating consequences only. Three things in After are close to the line and worth pinning in the wording. In Case A the deliver row now appends "then continue until merge is offered" to the single watch window, which a stricter reader could take as open-ended; say the obstacle deliver row is exactly one more window with no added attempts, and nothing after it. In Case C the reason narrowed from "nothing offered here can supply that approval" to "more repair attempts cannot supply it"; keep the broader phrasing so the stop pin clearly covers every non-stop action. The A-F reports now carry "the spec matches linked ticket APP-91"; no fact forbids a ticket ID there, but if tracker IDs are meant to stay out of explanatory prose, limit that mention to the report and never the reason line or contract sentences.
